body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Do not accept Strain on this card. Remove 1 Strain and gain +1 Composure against the next psychic attack before your next turn.

surges.html: Suppress one ordinary distraction penalty until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Trance
rider.html: Enter Still Water Trance until the end of your next turn: if you accept no Strain during an entire turn, you may burn 1 Action Die at its end to remove 1 Strain.
